disclosed.source: the prose of the filing's main document, read by scripts/lib/bdc-prose.mjs; every figure carries its sentence

assetCoverage.sentence: As of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025, our asset coverage ratios were 186% and 198%, respectively.
flags: tag 1.5 and prose 1.86 differ by more than 2 points

portfolioCompanies.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, we had investments in 104 portfolio companies with an aggregate fair value of approximately $2,267 million, and unfunded commitments to these portfolio companies of $293 million, and our portfolio consisted of 92.8% first lien senior secured loans, 5.3% subordinated debt and 1.9% equity investments.

nonAccrualCostPct.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, the Company's debt investments on non-accrual status comprised 4.5% and 2.7%, respectively, of total debt investments at cost and fair value.

nonAccrualFvPct.sentence: As of June 30, 2026, the Company's debt investments on non-accrual status comprised 4.5% and 2.7%, respectively, of total debt investments at cost and fair value.

intro.sentence: Assuming that the consolidated statement of assets and liabilities as of June 30, 2026 were to remain constant and that we took no actions to alter our existing interest rate sensitivity, the following table shows the annualized impact ($ in millions) of hypothetical base rate changes in interest rate (considering interest rate floors for floating rate instruments). We do not include investments on non-accrual status and classified as non-income producing as of June 30, 2026 in this calculation.

dividendSplit.sentence: On July 16, 2026, the Company paid a regular dividend of $0.40 per share to each common stockholder of record as of June 30, 2026.

targetLeverage.sentence: We currently intend to target asset coverage of 200% to 180% (which equates to a debt-to-equity ratio of 1.0x to 1.25x) but may alter this target based on market conditions.

internallyManaged.sentence: Kayne Anderson BDC, Inc. (the "Company") is an externally managed, closed-end, non-diversified management investment company that has elected to be regulated as a business development company ("BDC") under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (the "1940 Act").
